extraction.name: Visual Genome
extraction.description: The Visual Genome dataset contains over 100K images with dense annotations of objects, attributes, and relationships within each image. It includes region descriptions and question-answer pairs canonicalized to WordNet synsets to enable the modeling of visual relationships.
extraction.creator: Ranjay Krishna (Stanford University); Yuke Zhu (Stanford University); Oliver Groth (Dresden University of Technology); Justin Johnson (Stanford University); Kenji Hata (Stanford University); Joshua Kravitz (Stanford University); Stephanie Chen (Stanford University); Yannis Kalantidis (Yahoo Inc.); Li-Jia Li (Snapchat Inc.); David A. Shamma (Yahoo Inc.); Michael S. Bemstein (Stanford University); Li Fei-Fei (Stanford University)
extraction.citeAs: Ranjay Krishna, Yuke Zhu, Oliver Groth, Justin Johnson, Kenji Hata, Joshua Kravitz, Stephanie Chen, Yannis Kalantidis, Li-Jia Li, David A. Shamma, Michael S. Bemstein, Li Fei-Fei. Visual Genome: Connecting Language and Vision Using Crowdsourced Dense Image Annotations. arXiv:1602.07332 (2016).
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was assembled by selecting 108,249 images from the intersection of the YFCC100M and MS-COCO datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 108,249 real-world images from the intersection of the YFCC100M and MS-COCO datasets, originally uploaded onto Flickr by users.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Workers drew bounding boxes and wrote region descriptions, extracted objects from descriptions, added attributes and relationships, and wrote question-answer pairs. Bounding boxes had to satisfy coverage and quality requirements. Workers also verified WordNet synset mappings.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Annotations were verified using majority voting where three unique workers looked at each annotation and at least two votes were required for inclusion, while rapid judgments were used to verify objects.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: 93.02% from the United States; majority between 25 and 34 years old; 54.15% male; 45.85% female
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Stanford's dependency parser; Stanford NLP tools
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is somewhat biased towards images of people; Certain sports (skiing, surfboarding) are overrepresented due to an image source bias.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and benchmarking computer models for comprehensive scene understanding; Dense image captioning; Visual question answering; Image understanding evaluation; Relationship extraction; Semantic image retrieval
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data preprocessing included a verification stage to remove incorrectly labeled annotations and vague, subjective, or opinionated descriptions and QAs. Text preprocessing involved removing stop words, non-alphanumeric characters, and prepositions, as well as lowercasing, lemmatizing, stemming (morphological normalization), and stripping excess whitespace. Extracted concepts were canonicalized to WordNet synsets.
